name: powerauth-mobile-sdk-js-monorepo
title: PowerAuth Mobile SDK
description: Wultra PowerAuth Mobile SDK for React Native and Cordova

scripts.buildReactIos: yarn build:rn && yarn workspace testapp buildIos
scripts.buildReactAndroid: yarn build:rn && yarn workspace testapp buildAndroid
scripts.buildCordovaIos: yarn build:cdv && yarn workspace com.wultra.pwatest buildIos
scripts.buildCordovaAndroid: yarn build:cdv && yarn workspace com.wultra.pwatest buildAndroid
scripts.lint:sdk: yarn lint:rn && yarn lint:cordova && yarn lint:build
scripts.format:sdk: yarn format:rn && yarn format:cordova && yarn format:build
scripts.e2e:infra:build: yarn workspace mobile-testbed build && yarn workspace mobile-test-reporter build && yarn workspace mobile-test-runner build
scripts.e2e:collector: mkdir -p artifacts/e2e && node packages/mobile-test-runner/dist/cli.js collect --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8137 --out artifacts/e2e --expected-runs 1 --timeout 30m
scripts.e2e:collector:watch: mkdir -p artifacts/e2e && node packages/mobile-test-runner/dist/cli.js collect --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8137 --out artifacts/e2e --watch
scripts.e2e:local:rn: yarn e2e:clean && yarn e2e:infra:build && node scripts/e2e/run.cjs rn --platforms android,ios
scripts.e2e:local:cordova: yarn e2e:clean && yarn e2e:infra:build && node scripts/e2e/run.cjs cordova --platforms android,ios
scripts.e2e:local:full: yarn e2e:clean && yarn e2e:infra:build && node scripts/e2e/run.cjs full --platforms android,ios
scripts.e2e:ci:rn: yarn e2e:infra:build && node scripts/e2e/run.cjs rn --platforms android,ios --ci
scripts.e2e:ci:full: yarn e2e:infra:build && node scripts/e2e/run.cjs full --platforms android,ios --ci
